subject: general
question: On Centre-State relations, a commission had been set up by the government of India named Sarkaria Commission, in the year___.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1983.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Sarkaria Commission**

__
 
• **The Sarkaria Commission was set up in the year 1983** by the central government of India.
 
• It was founded in June 1983, by the Ministry of Home Affairs of the Indian Government under the **Chairmanship of Justice R.S. Sarkaria with Shri B. Sivaraman and Dr. S. R. Sen as its members.**
 
• The Sarkaria Commission's charter was to examine the central state relationship on various portfolios and suggest changes within the framework of the constitution of India.
 
• The first three-member commission for determining the relationship between the center and the state was presided over by R. S. Sarkaria.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Commission was so named as it was **headed by Justice Ranjit Singh Sarkaria,** the chairman of the commission and a retired judge of the Supreme Court of India.
 
• **The Commission will examine and review the working of the existing arrangements between the Union and States as per the Constitution of India,** the healthy precedents being followed, various pronouncements of the Courts in regard to powers, functions and responsibilities in all spheres including legislative relations.
 
• In examining and reviewing the working of the existing arrangements between the Union and States and making recommendations as to the changes and measures needed, the Commission will keep in view the social and economic developments that have taken place over the years, particularly over the last two decades.
